verdict.rationale: Community reports confirm Netlify has its own project config file, netlify.toml, with a [dev] section and simple redirect config. Nothing shows it defining functions, databases, env, or other architecture, or versioning the whole stack, and users say its [dev] section was poorly documented. missing for 10: first-party docs showing netlify.toml (or any single file) defines the entire architecture (functions, storage, database, env, domains), evidence that deploys are driven and versioned from that file, complete reference documentation for the config sections, independent hands-on corroboration of full-stack config-as-code.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can define, deploy, and version my entire architecture with a single configuration file

citations.quote: Setup a netlify.toml file with a [dev] section
